mostWorthwhile.text: Making rain on the rocky rise was most worthwhile: it linked rising, cooling air to rainfall in a concrete landscape.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating sunlight felt least engaging because it was the only available opening action and its result was predictable.

surprise.text: The ending brought the larger story together by linking hydrogen from the young universe and stellar-made oxygen to the water at the shore.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the offered combinations followed the water cycle and then reflected sunlight onto the sea.

continue.text: Probably not immediately: the water cycle and moonlit ending gave this chapter a satisfying conclusion, though the educational explanations were clear.
